pivotal_claim_checks.claim: Mahisha displaces the gods after a hundred-year conflict and they seek a means to kill him.
The gods' radiances converge as Devi, followed by source-specified divine gifts.
Devi's roar draws Mahisha's army; her lion and breath-born troops fight it.
Cikshura, Chamara and the remaining named chiefs are defeated before Mahisha enters directly.
Mahisha attacks in buffalo form and shifts through lion, armed man, elephant and buffalo forms.
Devi restrains and kills Mahisha after he partly emerges from the buffalo form.
The gods praise Devi and request protection; their cosmic assertions are praise, not neutral narrator declarations.
Devi grants aid on remembrance in calamity and prosperity to mortal hymn-singers, then disappears.
